signature.one_line: Zero-cut single-take talking head carried by one persistent two-box header (light box topic over dark box value range); list withholds final item for DM CTA.
unique_devices: Stacked two-box header held for 100 % of runtime: square light box with the topic (Title Case) over a narrower square dark box with a value/price range, 0.9 % H gap, spanning 12.5-25.6 % height
Zero-edit delivery: one continuous take, no captions, no b-roll, no punch-ins, no transitions; the header is the only design layer
Withheld-final-item CTA: deliver all but the last list item, then offer the 'best' item via DM in the final ~4 % of runtime
signature.why_it_works: The header states topic and value before the first sentence ends; the numbered promise and the withheld last item keep viewers to the end and drive DMs.

hook.type: open loop: numbered promise plus two pain removals, direct address
hook.first_frame: static centred medium close-up of the speaker at a desk mic, bright window behind, two-box header already on screen at the top

structure.what: numbered promise (N best ways) and two things the viewer will not have to do
why the common approach fails; contrarian framing builds authority
method 1 explained, including a spoken outreach script
method 2 with concrete percentages and deal sizes, win-win logic
final (best) method withheld; viewer told to DM their situation to get it

pacing.note: one continuous take: median shot = full runtime, no cuts, nothing changes on screen; fast continuous speech carries it

background_text.what: persistent two-box header: line 1 topic on a square light box, line 2 value/price range on a square dark box
background_text.how: line 1 box x 5.1-94.9 %, y 12.5-18.9 %; line 2 box x 10.1-87.5 %, y 19.8-25.6 %; 0.9 % H gap; text centred, light geometric sans 51 px at 1080x1920; no radius, stroke, shadow or animation; present from frame 0, never exits

cards_lists.what: spoken-only numbered list (no on-screen list cards)
cards_lists.how: list items exist only in speech; the header carries the count and value promise

layout.how: speaker centred, head at ~35-50 % height under the header, desk mic covering the chest in the lower third

camera.how: no punch-ins, no reframes, no camera moves

header_line1.font_class: thin geometric sans (circular O and 0, single-storey g), light weight

closest_match.note: Poppins has the right proportions; the original stroke is lighter (~300)

header_line1.ink_note: ink height measured on a thin-stroke Title Case line with a 2-px row threshold

header_line2.ink_note: same measure; line 2 is a value/price range with brackets and digits

other_text_spec.when: frame 0 to the last frame (100 % of runtime)
other_text_spec.note: no running speech captions; these tiers describe the persistent two-box header, the only text layer

layout.boxes: square corners, no radius, no shadow; each box is ~2-5 % W wider than its text on each side

style.look_intent: cool, high-contrast, natural saturation; teal-leaning bright window background against warm skin, soft selfie light

sound.music: possible music bed (heuristic, gap level -17.2 dB below speech); mood not inferable
sfx: none (no cuts or graphics to hit)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: the user has one long uncut selfie take and wants minimal editing
the concept is a numbered how-to / methods list with a lead-generation (DM) goal
a fast, articulate speaker (200+ wpm) can hold attention without cuts
the brand wants a clean, low-effort persistent title that states topic and value range
avoid_when: the target is high-retention short-form pacing (needs a visual change every few seconds)
the audience watches muted (no captions in this blueprint)
there is b-roll, screen material or proof to show
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B34 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B34.json) to this brand.
Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps. All positions are % of frame; px are at 1080x1920.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: header text must stay >= 4.5:1 on its own box, and the two boxes must read as light-over-dark)
- {{TEXT}}      line 1 text on the light box      default #101010
- {{ACCENT}}    line 2 box fill (dark bar)        default #010101
- {{ACCENT_2}}  line 2 text on the dark bar       default #FFFFFF
- {{SURFACE}}   not used (footage fills the frame) default none
- {{CARD_BG}}   line 1 box fill (light box)       default #FDFDFD
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} header font                    default Poppins 500 (Poppins Light 300 / Jost Light if available; the look is a light geometric sans)
- {{FONT_BODY}}    same as display                default Poppins 500
- {{HANDLE}}    not shown on screen (spoken DM CTA only)
- {{LOGO}}      not used

CAPTIONS
1. Add NO running speech captions.

OTHER TEXT
2. One static 2-line header, on screen for 100 % of the runtime (frame 0 to last frame, no entry/exit animation):
   - Line 1 (topic, Title Case, e.g. "Headline here"): {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 51 px, {{TEXT}}, centred on a square {{CARD_BG}} box spanning x 5.1-94.9 %, y 12.5-18.9 % (text centre y 16.0 %).
   - Line 2 (value / price range, Title Case, e.g. "(Range) Key Word"): same font at 51 px, {{ACCENT_2}}, centred on a square {{ACCENT}} box spanning x 10.1-87.5 %, y 19.8-25.6 % (text centre y 22.8 %), 0.9 % of height below the light box.
   - Each box is ~2-5 % W wider than its text on each side. No radius, stroke or shadow. Tracking 0em. Proof-read both lines.

EDIT DEVICES
3. Keep the take whole: no cuts, punch-ins, b-roll or transitions. Only trim the head/tail.
4. Structure: numbered promise in the first ~9 % of runtime; deliver all list items but the last; in the final ~4 % withhold the last ("best") item behind a spoken "DM me" CTA.

GRADE
5. Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: cool, high-contrast, natural saturation, teal-leaning background against warm skin.

AUDIO
6. Master speech to about -15 LUFS integrated with true peak <= -1 dBTP. No SFX. An optional faint music bed sits ~17 dB under speech.

VERIFY before rendering
a) Render a test frame with the user's header text (or "KEY WORD" on both lines) at 51 px and measure (thin strokes: use a 2-px row threshold):
   python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test.mp4> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.07,0.13,0.93,0.188 --ink "{{TEXT}}:90"
   python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test.mp4> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.11,0.2,0.86,0.255 --ink "{{ACCENT_2}}:90"
b) Expected ink for the actual words: video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py with {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 51 px (reference ink height ~2.7-2.8 % of H for a Title Case line). Required: measured ink within ±0.5 % H of the fit_font.py value; box edges within ±1 % of the geometry above; colours equal to the tokens.
